placements.why: This envelope's content is a concrete database/technology selection (adopting Zypherion for the analytics pipeline) — an organizational-architecture choice about the technical stack, justified by performance and scheduled by a migration timeline. No strata category exists yet in this repo. Architecture is the named top-level category in the org's own taxonomy that exactly holds infrastructure and technology-stack decisions like this one, so it is minted standalone as the home for this and future architecture decisions rather than leaving the content strata-less.

placements.why: All four expressions describe the same recurring subject: a database technology being adopted for the analytics pipeline (src-1), justified by a quantified performance comparison (src-2), committed to a migration schedule (src-3), and later re-recorded as a settled summary of that same decision (src-4). This is a subject future envelopes about infrastructure decisions, their performance justifications, and migration progress will keep feeding — not a one-time fact. The graph and strata are both empty, so no existing leaf could hold it; it is minted under the newly-minted Architecture strata as the exact-fit home for technology-stack decisions of this kind. The 15x figure itself is evidence for this leaf, not a leaf of its own, per the narrative grain test.
